source.name: Codex-authored repeated-explanation holdout
source.notes: Codex synthetic writing, repaired and independently reviewed against definitions frozen at eb8390ac before detector evaluation. The source commit identifies those definitions. Final reviewer context, requested model, reviewed counts, and selection are recorded in runners/results/repeated-explanation-holdout-review.json; the complete writing is versioned in this dataset pair. Selected 100 hits and 100 no-hits; the complete reviewed pool and surplus remain at Git commit 1f29be1fef04421cdebc6cbb89a2662ff07bf511.

instructions: Protected holdout: keep writing, labels, snippets, and case-specific reviews out of prompt-authoring contexts. Run only after candidate freeze and explicit holdout authorization.

snippets: A draft remains editable until submission; after submission, amendments are recorded as separate entries. This keeps the original inspection record intact.
The original inspection record remains intact because later amendments are stored separately from the submission.
Because amendments are separate entries, the submitted inspection is preserved in its original form.

A reservation reduces the quantity available for new jobs without changing the number physically on the shelf. This prevents the same stock being promised to two jobs before either job reaches the bench.
Reserving parts keeps them from being offered to another job even though they have not yet left the shelf.

Rowan charges separately for a return visit after a failed inspection; Mere includes one such visit per lift. A comparison using only the scheduled-visit price leaves out a cost that would arise when defects need checking again.
Since Rowan bills for checking a repaired defect again and Mere includes that check, the scheduled inspection fees alone omit part of the cost of a failed inspection.
For a first rollout, start with one aisle so supervisors can check the results before extending the process to the whole store.
Begin the rollout in a single aisle and inspect its results before taking the process across the store.
We recommend checking one aisle's results at the start of the rollout, then expanding to the remaining store.

The packing bench held leaflets for two similar models, and the operator selected the pile nearest the cartons. The model name was printed inside the leaflet rather than on its cover, so the normal cover check did not distinguish them.
The similar models' leaflets shared the bench, and the cover gave no model name to help the operator identify the wrong pile during the check.
Borrowers could not reliably match the drawer entry to the contents because the descriptions did not follow a common naming system.
The old drawer arrangement had made identification difficult because donors described plants in different ways, leaving borrowers unable to connect an entry consistently with the seeds inside.
Use the model number from the appliance's own rating plate when saving its manual. A product's shop name can cover several versions with different controls and parts.
When downloading instructions, rely on the number printed on the appliance rather than its retail name, since the same name may describe versions with different parts and controls.
Keep the purchase date in a separate note if the receipt is likely to fade, and record the retailer's order reference while it is still easy to find.
Receipts can become unreadable over time, so copy the purchase date into the folder note instead of relying on the original paper to preserve it.
Cedar can operate the three doors we need without a central server. Gatewell's server and building-wide controls would add equipment and maintenance for functions this branch will not use.
For three branch doors, Cedar avoids the server and maintenance that Gatewell would require for unused building-wide functions.
Two drawers that look identical in a photograph can have different runners or front clips. For this reason, the appliance model number is more useful than the brand name when ordering a replacement.

Choosing by model code is the reliable approach because similar-looking drawers may have different clips and runners. The brand and a photograph are less useful than the complete appliance number when deciding which replacement to buy.

Reed's unit price is lower, but its minimum run would leave us buying roughly four months of cartons at once. We do not have dry space for that quantity while the second packing line is being installed.
Staying with Westfold avoids a four-month purchase that exceeds our available dry storage, despite Reed's cheaper carton price.
The shorter journey should reduce the time residents spend without the lift after a call-out, which is the main concern raised at the tenants' meeting.
A locally based Atlas engineer has less travelling to do after a fault, reducing the period residents are left without a working lift.
Atlas's nearby engineer remains the stronger fit because less travel after a call-out means a shorter interruption for residents.
Its local clock had moved an hour ahead after a configuration import, so the reader treated valid morning access as being outside the permitted schedule.
The hour-ahead clock had placed arriving staff outside their authorized access window.
The reader was an hour fast, causing the morning card attempts to fall outside the allowed schedule.
We need the visit time because crowding at the gate may depend on when people arrive, and a comment without that detail is harder to relate to the daily pattern.

In your comments, the time matters because it helps us identify whether gate crowding is concentrated at particular points in the day. Without knowing when a visit happened, it is difficult to place that feedback in the daily use pattern.

The stock update from the warehouse failed after a product code was changed, leaving the old available quantity on the shop. The shop continued selling against that stale quantity until customer service noticed the discrepancy.
An unsuccessful warehouse update left an obsolete stock figure online after the code change, allowing the shop to take orders for lamps no longer available.

Printed copies can shrink unevenly, and a later reproduction may have been resized to fit a page. Measure a known grid interval on the particular copy being used rather than assuming that its stated scale remains accurate.
Before deriving distances, verify the scale against a known grid interval on the actual copy, since resizing and uneven shrinkage can make the printed scale unreliable.
Although the stairs remained open, groups could not book a room that some members could not reach.
With the old lift out of service, the stairs alone had prevented bookings by groups whose members needed step-free access.
The centre's public programme became smaller because several groups now competed for the same two accessible rooms.
The booking diary had been crowded because losing the upstairs space left all groups sharing two rooms at ground level.
She needs the actual file, including any video clips, because the studio laptop will be offline while we record. A link to the shared drive will not let her load it there.

On the slides, the studio computer has no connection to our drive during recording. That is why Nia needs copies of the files rather than shared links: without internet access, a link will not provide the presentation.
Large archives show a link as soon as the job starts, before the file is ready.
The blank download page reflects an archive that is still being prepared, since the link appears before the file is complete.
Staff had reset it after changing the battery without checking a reference tide. The new battery restored the movement, while leaving the displayed phase incorrect.
Changing the battery had made the hand move again but had not aligned it with the tide cycle, because the reset was done without a reference tide.

Its labels survived the watering trial with the print still legible, while two of Flint Print's samples blurred. Labels need to remain readable outdoors, so Bracken's performance outweighs Flint's modest price saving.
Its readable print after watering remains a better basis for this outdoor order than Flint's slightly cheaper labels, which blurred in the trial.
The replacement card has a new security code, so the saved details at the parking app will need updating.
The app's saved code belongs to the previous card and needs replacing for authorization to work.
A cancellation and a card refund are separate records. The shop can cancel an order immediately, while the payment still has to travel through its payment service and your card issuer.

The gap between the email and the statement follows from the two systems doing different jobs. Cancelling changes the retailer's order record first; returning a completed card payment takes a further journey through the payment service and issuer. That is why the email can arrive before the money does.
Those units cannot be dispatched, so counting them as available would promise customers goods that the warehouse cannot supply.

Keeping damaged goods out of availability matters because they cannot be sent to customers. If they remain in the usable total, sales could offer stock that is physically present but unfit to dispatch.
Numbers restarted each January, which meant the year had to be included to distinguish one job from another.
Because the numbering began again at the start of every year, the date's year was needed alongside the number to identify a job reliably.

That mark sat beside the amount rather than replacing it, and the first version of the spreadsheet copied the amount without recording the cancellation. Adding those entries into a sales total would therefore count work that had never proceeded.
The red cancellation marks meant that amounts could remain visible for abandoned orders, and treating every written amount as completed business would overstate sales.
A date-first name keeps the files in time order when the folder is sorted by name, so you can follow changes in a bed without opening every image.
Begin each name with the capture date so a name-sorted folder follows the seasons without requiring every picture to be opened,
Use the existing mount with the new camera. Its screw pattern and load rating match the replacement model, so buying another mount would add no benefit for this installation.
I would retain the mount already on the wall: it supports the new camera and has the right screw spacing, making a fresh mount unnecessary.
A loading window belongs to the route rather than to a particular driver, so changing the assigned driver leaves the booked window in place.
When a different driver takes over a route, the loading reservation continues unchanged because it is attached to that route, not to the driver.

I recommend holding the regional training days in our own offices rather than hiring a central venue. The regional rooms are already equipped, and using them avoids venue hire and most overnight travel.
On balance, the regional-office option remains the better choice. It uses rooms that are already equipped and saves the cost of hiring a central venue, while removing most overnight journeys.
Volunteers spent most of the last session finding sizes instead of helping families, and sorting in advance will free them to answer questions.

Sorting donations into sizes before arrival will let the volunteers spend their time helping families. At the previous exchange, searching for sizes took up time that could have been used to answer people's questions.

Their equipment is compatible with our existing receiver, so we can replace the damaged handheld units without replacing the entire system. Ardent Audio's package requires a new receiver as well as new microphones.

We can retain the present receiver by buying Dales' compatible handhelds, avoiding the complete replacement required by Ardent's package. Dales is therefore the appropriate supplier for this microphone order.

Work on a copy of the audio file, keeping the original unchanged. Noise reduction and edits can remove quiet speech along with unwanted sound, and an untouched source lets you return to material that a later listener may want.
Preserve the source without edits, since processing that reduces background noise may also erase faint words; the unchanged file is what allows those words to be reconsidered later.
Evaporation draws energy from the cloth and its immediate surroundings, lowering the cloth's temperature.

The damp covering cools because water leaving its surface as vapour takes energy from the covering and nearby material. This energy transfer explains why the wet thermometer can read below the surrounding air temperature.
A damaged probe cable caused the controller to report a false high temperature; the room itself remained cold.
The controller's high reading was an effect of the damaged probe wire, while the room stayed within its normal cold range.

The arrangement caused confusion because the street sign pointed toward the building's front, while the open door was around the corner. People often tried the locked front entrance and assumed the museum was closed.

The locked front door had been misleading because the street sign directed visitors to the front while admission was through the side; people reaching the wrong door concluded that the museum was shut.

A scheduled export waited for a report job that was still running, so the payment file was created thirty-eight minutes later than planned. The file was valid, but the delay moved settlement to the next working day.
Waiting behind the report made the otherwise valid payment file miss the cutoff and settle a day later.
The report's extended run held up the payment export until after the bank's deadline, pushing settlement into the following working day.
The restart created a second job rather than resuming the first.
The editor's restart had created an additional sending job while the first one remained active.
The dashboard stopped updating at 11:18 because its live-status connection had closed. Message delivery uses a separate connection and continued normally.
The dashboard's lost status connection hid progress without stopping delivery, since those functions use different connections.

The share can rise because other reservations fell while large-print requests stayed constant. Percentages describe a relationship between a category and its total, so changes in either quantity affect the result.

The central implication is that a higher percentage of large-print reservations need not mean more such reservations: a fall in the other requests can enlarge the share while the large-print count stays unchanged.

We have three trainers, and groups of four will give each customer a chance to practise on the test equipment. With a larger group, some people would have to watch instead of completing the exercise themselves.

Twelve is the right limit because three trainers can each support four customers at the equipment. Increasing attendance would leave some customers observing rather than getting their own practice, which is why I want to hold that number.

Waitlist offers now expire after six hours, allowing the next person in the queue to receive the place when an offer goes unanswered. An expired offer leaves the original customer on the waitlist at their existing position.
When six hours pass without acceptance, the offer is withdrawn so the place can be offered to the next waiting customer. The customer who did not answer keeps their previous queue position.
Cancelled sessions appear with a grey stripe until the end of the day. This lets reception staff see why an expected class has disappeared from the active timetable.
Grey-striped cancellations remain visible through the day so staff can account for sessions removed from the active calendar.
Opening hours remain unchanged.
There is no change to the library's timetable during these repairs. The building will open and close at its normal times even though the entrance has moved.

Print one invitation on the actual card before ordering the full batch. A screen preview will not show how the ink behaves on a textured surface or whether the card feeds cleanly. The test copy should use the same paper, printer settings, and fold that you intend to use for the finished invitations.

A sample on the chosen stock remains necessary because viewing the file on screen cannot reveal textured-paper ink results or feeding problems; use the intended fold and printer setup for that sample.
Some rain was being intercepted before reaching the funnel, so the recorded total could understate rainfall at the site.
The hedge and overhanging tree could catch rainfall before it entered the old gauge, making that position record less than the amount falling on the site.
Interception by the hedge and tree was the reason the sheltered gauge could register an artificially low rainfall total.
Your assistant can edit appointments but cannot issue refunds because that permission belongs to the account owner.
Regarding the refund button, it remains unavailable to your assistant because only an owner has the permission to send a customer's payment back.

Those with time, literacy, useful contacts, or access to a meeting place were better positioned to turn a grievance into a document. The surviving signatures therefore reflect opportunities for participation as well as the distribution of opinion.

Participation in petitioning was shaped by practical access: people with literacy, contacts, and time could organize a submission more readily, so the signatures measure organizing opportunities as well as opinion.

Household spending figures should be adjusted for household size before being used to compare living standards. A budget supporting five people cannot be interpreted in the same way as the same budget supporting one.
Before comparing living standards, researchers therefore need to account for how many people a household budget supports; the same expenditure means something different for one resident and for five.
Removing a pause changes the evidence available about timing even when every spoken word remains.
Editing out silences alters the timing evidence, even if the transcript retains all of the words that were spoken.
The main point is that retaining the words while removing pauses still changes what can be inferred about the timing of the exchange.
Your export includes revision history, so each saved revision appears as a separate row.
The repeated application entries come from exporting all saved revisions rather than just each application's latest version.
Their weekly minimum is lower than Stone Wharf's, which suits our uneven trade outside the tourist season. We can meet Alder's minimum in a quiet week without storing beans until they lose freshness.
Their smaller minimum remains the better fit for slow weeks, avoiding a stockpile of beans that would go stale before we used them.
Hillcrest's approach should keep the display presentable through a busy weekend without paying for a second complete arrangement.
Replacing only tired flowers during the week would let Hillcrest maintain the display for weekend arrivals without the expense of another whole arrangement.
Hillcrest left enough clear space for two guests to check in together. The Stem Room would need to reduce the arrangement's width to preserve that working area.
Hillcrest's narrower sample also preserves space for two simultaneous check-ins; The Stem Room's broader display would have to shrink to do the same.
Dirt and body oils can interfere with the fabric's performance. Leaving a jacket dirty for fear of damaging the coating may therefore make it less comfortable in wet weather.

The main point about cleaning remains that grime and skin oils can reduce how well the jacket works. Keeping it unwashed to protect it can leave those contaminants in place and make wearing it in rain less comfortable.
The weekly email is generated from saved searches, so turning off dashboard alerts will not stop it.
The email continues because its schedule belongs to the saved search, independently of dashboard alerts.
The dates in your CSV are export dates rather than visit dates.
Likewise, the CSV is showing when the export ran, not when each visit occurred.

Customers currently ring whichever engineer helped them last, which leaves us unable to tell whether a call has reached the person on cover. One published number will put those calls into the duty queue.

Using one number also addresses the problem of customers calling a previous engineer directly. Those calls do not reliably reach the current duty engineer, whereas the shared number sends them to the duty queue.
The employee still submits the finished claim, so delegation does not move responsibility for confirming the expenses.
Delegated preparation still requires the employee to submit the claim themselves, leaving the confirmation of those expenses with that employee.
The delivery van is moving to a midweek route, and Wednesday opening lets volunteers put fresh items out on the day they arrive.
Opening on the delivery day means the fresh food can go straight onto the shelves. The change to a Wednesday van route is therefore the reason for replacing Saturday opening with a Wednesday session.
When the two names differ, the person at the table may sell a plant under the wrong entry and the remaining stock count becomes unreliable.
A different name on the pot makes it difficult to select the correct list entry, which can leave the stock tally wrong.
Matching the wording on the pots to the sales list prevents purchases being recorded against the wrong plant and keeps the count of unsold stock dependable.
The visible stamp carried a cancellation date, but that date showed when the parcel entered the postal system, not when it became trapped behind the desk.
The cancellation dated the parcel's passage through the post rather than its fall behind the sorting desk, so it did not establish how long the parcel had occupied that gap.
Uncollected pages have been left in the tray, where visitors can see them. Releasing a job in person will keep those pages from sitting unattended.

The held queue prevents sensitive pages from remaining in the output tray for visitors to read. Requiring the sender to be present when printing starts removes the unattended-paper problem that prompted this change.
Several members work shifts and cannot reach their plots before the present closing time. The later closing will give those members time to water and harvest after work.
Staying open later will help members whose shifts prevent them from arriving during the existing hours. Extending access into the evening means they can tend their crops after finishing work.

Visit a possible venue at the time your reading group would meet. A room that seems quiet on a weekday morning may sit beside a busy class in the evening. Checking during the proposed slot gives you evidence about noise and access that a daytime viewing cannot provide.
Make the viewing coincide with the intended meeting hour, because noise and entry conditions at that time can differ from those seen during a quiet daytime visit.

The litres-per-day figure on a dehumidifier is measured under stated test conditions. It is not a promise that the machine will collect that amount in your spare room every day. Cooler air and a lower starting humidity can produce much less water, even when the machine is working normally.
Actual collection in a cool, fairly dry room can be much lower than that advertised rate without indicating a fault.
A low daily collection can be normal in a cooler room with less moisture to remove, since the rated daily output is a test result rather than a guaranteed yield in that room.

Separate attachments have left us with competing revisions, and we have been merging changes that were made to different versions. Keeping comments on one document will let us resolve them against the same text.

Using a single commented document avoids the competing versions created by emailed attachments. It means we can settle changes in the same text rather than spend time merging edits from different copies.
Vale's lease includes a replacement machine during repairs. With only one wash station, losing the machine would force us to reduce service or hire temporary equipment ourselves.
For a kitchen with a single wash station, Vale's repair replacement avoids cutting service or arranging an emergency hire, which is why the lease is preferable to Norham's cheaper purchase.
We need each journey against the site it served, because the client reimburses travel by site rather than as a single monthly total. The ordinary office form does not have a site field.

The site breakdown is necessary because that is how the client repays the travel costs. A single monthly travel amount cannot be matched to the separate sites, which is why the office form will not serve for these claims.
The finance folder is for invoices and payment records, so the agreement would be hard to find there when purchasing checks the renewal date.
The agreement belongs with the supplier records because that is where purchasing looks for contract dates. Filing it among payment documents would make the renewal check harder.
Tickets sold at the door went into a separate cash book that has been lost. Totalling the ledger therefore counts reserved seats rather than everyone who attended.
The reservations alone cannot yield the full attendance because door sales were kept in the missing cash book.
Please return only one response per household, since the results will be counted by address rather than by individual resident.
Each address should send a single completed form. As the count is based on households, receiving separate forms from people at the same address would mean counting that household more than once.

Keep each envelope with its letter. Postmarks, return addresses, and handwritten notes on an envelope can help identify when and where the letter was sent. Separating the two removes evidence that may be absent from the letter itself.
The envelopes should remain paired with the letters because their postal marks and address details preserve information about place and date that the sheets may not contain.
We are using advance sales because the hall has a fixed seating limit and we need to know attendance before setting out the chairs.
The fixed number of seats is also the reason for selling tickets before the evening itself. Knowing how many people are coming allows us to arrange the chairs within the hall's limit.
A heater's physical size does not tell you its electricity use. A compact heater rated at two kilowatts draws roughly the same power at full output as a larger heater with the same rating.
Choosing a small casing is not an energy-saving decision by itself. At equal power ratings, the compact heater and the large one can consume electricity at the same rate when their elements are on.
These links collect answers without attaching the respondent's account identifier to the response.
Anonymous-link answers remain detached from an account identity, so the link lets people respond without their user identifier being added to the submission.
every packet needs the plant name and the year it was collected. Those details help the next gardener judge what they are taking and how fresh it is.

Labelling is important because a recipient needs to know the plant and the age of the seed. Adding the name and collection year allows the person who takes a packet to identify its contents and assess its freshness.
The scale is restarting because the battery contacts are losing contact when weight is applied.
As weight presses on the scale, the loose battery connection briefly interrupts power and makes the display restart.
Recalibrating will not repair the loose contact.
That is why adjusting calibration will leave this problem unchanged.
Individual occurrences can be cancelled without removing the rest of the series, allowing teams to release space during holidays.
Cancelling an individual date frees that day's desks while leaving the other recurring dates reserved, which lets a team release desks for a holiday.

Some new wool rugs release loose fibres during their first months of use. Those fibres are left from manufacture and finishing, and their appearance on the surface does not necessarily mean that the rug is unravelling.

The loose material on a new wool rug often comes from fibres remaining after it was made and finished. Seeing those fibres need not mean the rug is coming apart; they can work their way out during the early period of use.
We chose shared crops because dividing the small space into private plots would leave very little growing room once paths were included. A shared bed uses more of the available ground for plants.

Individual plots would use too much of this small site for access paths, leaving less space to grow things. Growing the crops together therefore makes better use of the ground than allocating separate plots.
Some grounds remain in the chute or around the burrs. That retained coffee can emerge with the next dose, so weighing beans at the start does not always tell you exactly what reaches the filter.
grounds held around the burrs may still join a later dose. This retained material is why the beans weighed before grinding and the grounds collected afterwards may differ.
People who joined after that point were never recorded. The count described crossings at one location rather than the total number of people using the path.
The old figure remained a measure of passages past one point, since users entering farther along the route did not cross its beam; it could not stand for everyone visiting the path.
The earlier counter could only describe traffic at its own location, not total use of a path that people could join beyond it.
Several provisional dates have remained on separate calendars, making it difficult to tell which rooms are free. One office calendar will give the caretaker a complete record.
Finally, the office calendar will resolve the uncertainty created by separate committee diaries. Keeping all room reservations together gives the caretaker the full booking picture.
We recommend arranging a viewing before paying a deposit. A viewing lets you check whether the room and kitchen suit the event while you still have a choice of venue.
Checking the room in person before committing money is advisable because it allows you to decide whether the facilities fit your plans before choosing the hall.

The remaining measurements will be warmer because the network now samples lower ground. A shift in the places being measured can therefore produce a shift in the average without a corresponding change at any individual site.

If cool, elevated sites drop out and warmer valley sites remain, the overall mean rises simply because different locations contribute to it, even though conditions at the continuing stations have not changed.
Editing the copy changes only the new assessment; the source rubric and marks already awarded with it remain unchanged.
Changes to a reused rubric stay within its new assessment and leave the original rubric and its existing marks as they were.

The labels named productions rather than their contents. A coat used in several plays could be filed under whichever production had last needed it, so a search by garment could miss something already in the store.
Because the old boxes followed the last production to use an item, a garment could be hidden from a search even while it was sitting in storage,
Speakers fit unfamiliar sounds into the categories available in their own language. A borrowed word may therefore reveal the receiving language's sound system as much as the donor's pronunciation.
Consequently, the pronunciation of a loanword reflects adjustment to the sound categories of the language receiving it, rather than serving as a direct recording of the donor language.
The earliest written occurrence establishes that the word was in use by that date; it does not establish the moment when speakers first adopted it.
Finally, the date of the first surviving written example tells us the word existed by then, not when borrowing began.
The current Glossy setting uses less ink on this model, which is why the colors look pale on your uncoated stock.
Choosing the matte setting will give the uncoated sheet more ink and restore the stronger colors missing from the glossy-mode print.

Start one email thread for each repair and keep subsequent updates in that thread. A single conversation lets the property manager see the original description, photographs, and later changes together. Starting a fresh message for every update separates information that needs to be considered as one request.

Use the same email conversation for later developments so that the first description and all updates stay together; separate messages make the manager reconstruct the request from scattered correspondence.

Number the display areas on the plan and use those numbers in your image filenames. This connection lets someone reconstruct where objects stood after the exhibition has been dismantled. A folder of attractive close-ups alone will not preserve the arrangement.
Use the room plan's display numbers in the filenames so that a later reader can recover the arrangement once the room is empty; isolated close-up photographs do not show where the objects stood.
the morning bus arrived at the station ten minutes after the group normally left. Members using the bus therefore had to find another way into the village or miss the walk.
Under the old arrangement, the bus reached the station after the walkers had already departed from the post office, leaving bus passengers dependent on another means of reaching the start.
The screen preview does not show how the pale grey text looks on the uncoated paper, so we need to judge a printed copy rather than the PDF alone.

A paper sample matters because pale grey type behaves differently on this stock from the way it appears in a screen preview. We cannot decide its legibility from the PDF, which is why the approval needs to be based on the printed sheet.

When water is assigned to the tray, all its seeds share that treatment, soil, and position. The tray is the experimental unit for the watering comparison. Counting each seed as an independent replicate would make the evidence appear more extensive than the design supports.

The comparison rests on trays because the watering treatment was delivered to each tray as a whole; the seeds inside it share their conditions and cannot be counted as separate independent watering trials.
The second line in your banking app is an authorization, which reserves money while the payment is being checked. It will disappear rather than become a second payment.
The pending amount is a temporary reservation during the payment check, so it will drop away instead of being collected again.
Please keep the current order and cancel the duplicate. That will preserve your original delivery slot, whereas replacing both orders would put you at the back of the queue.
My recommendation is to retain the first order and remove the extra one, keeping the delivery appointment already reserved rather than starting again in the queue.
The reminder template still named the main entrance, which is closed during building work. The template had not been included in the temporary-access review.
The reminder therefore directed patients to the closed main entrance because its template had been omitted from the temporary-access review.
We should treat Severn as a weekday service when planning room turnaround, since the weekend route is not guaranteed.
The daily route is less useful for our busiest changeovers if the driver may not come at weekends. Severn's availability clause leaves us needing a weekday-based plan for linen turnaround.
Severn's advertised daily collection should still be regarded as a weekday arrangement for our planning because weekend attendance remains conditional.
The overnight job had reused a saved batch setting instead of obtaining the identifier for Tuesday. The carrier rejected those labels as belonging to a collection it had already closed.
Because the batch job had carried yesterday's collection setting into Tuesday's labels, the scanner had treated the parcels as part of a closed collection.

The lower safety edge had been compressed by a loose strip of packaging, causing the controller to interpret an obstruction and stop movement. Removing the packaging restored normal travel without changing the motor or controller.
The controller had stopped the shutter because trapped packaging pressed the safety edge as though an obstruction were present; clearing that strip allowed the shutter to travel normally.

The width printed beside a sofa is usually its overall width in use. That number alone does not establish whether it will pass through a doorway. Height, depth, the shape of the arms and the space available for turning all affect the route into the room.

The listed width is only one part of the fit question. A sofa also has height and depth, and its arms and turning space determine whether it can travel through the doorway. Looking at width by itself cannot tell you that it will get inside.
Adding a file to a bundle references the existing file rather than creating another copy, so storage use does not increase with each bundle.
Bundles keep references to files already stored, which avoids storing another copy each time a bundle is made.
Later edits to a source file do not silently change an existing bundle; an owner must choose Update versions to bring those edits in.
A bundle continues using its selected file versions after the sources are edited, until its owner explicitly updates those versions.
The economy setting uses gentler heat over a longer period, allowing water and detergent more time to loosen food. A longer running time therefore need not mean a larger electricity bill.

The apparent puzzle about duration has a straightforward answer: economy washing substitutes time for higher temperatures, so an extended cycle can consume less electricity than a shorter hot one. The clock alone does not tell you how much energy the machine uses.

Give every shared tool a marked place. A visible outline, hook label, or shelf label makes a missing item apparent and gives borrowers an unambiguous place to return it. Without that cue, a tool can be present in the shed but effectively lost among unrelated equipment.

Each tool should have its own labelled location so that people can see what is absent and know exactly where to put it back; equipment left among miscellaneous objects can be difficult to find even when it has been returned.
Twelve calendar-month payments and thirteen four-week payments cover roughly the same year, so comparing the stated monthly figures without checking the billing period can be misleading.

The billing period deserves care because a four-week charge repeats thirteen times over approximately a year, whereas a calendar-month charge repeats twelve times. The lower-looking monthly quote may therefore represent more payments.
A room billed in advance may require notice before the next charge, so telling the office on moving day can be too late to avoid another payment.
Also remember that notice must precede the next charge under some advance-billed agreements. If you wait until the day you empty the room, you may already owe the following payment.

The kiosk order had been printed on the previous day's route sheet after a date filter was left unchanged. The packer used the current sheet, so those trays were never placed in the driver's collection area.
Because the retained date filter put the kiosk order on yesterday's route sheet, it was absent from the sheet used to assemble today's driver collection.
